strategy: Follow the skill tree progression stages while maintaining adequate defenses and resource management. Prioritize upgrading your weapon, use Vortex for grouping, and increase difficulty when content becomes too easy, reaching level 70 to unlock Paragon and transition to Torment 1 endgame content via War Plans.

paragon.note: Canny is only used in steps 4-5; Outmatch replaces it later to maximize Convergence. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
